summary: Registrations in the IANA "RTP Payload Format Media Types" registry were often skipped, even though RFC 8088 recommended them. To simplify things, this RFC closes that special registry and relies only on the general "Media Types" registry for RTP payload formats.

eli5.summary: There were two lists tracking the same things and people kept forgetting one. This closes the extra list so there is only one place to look.

questions: why was the rtp payload format media types registry closed
where to register rtp payload media types
